utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: This Status Conference is called to order. Good afternoon to everybody. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-95-14-A, the Prosecutor versus Tihomir Blaskic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. So may I call for the appearances. For the Prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Norman Farrell, with the case manager, Mr. Wolfgang Sakulin, for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. May I now ask, Mr. Blaskic, do you hear me? Do you hear the proceedings correctly? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. I can hear you well. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Blaskic. Please sit down. Now, the purpose of this Status Conference is well known. I don't have to elaborate on it. On the one hand, under Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules, the purpose is to allow the appellant to express any concerns he may have as to his detention conditions directly or through his counsel. On the other hand, we should update the appellant with respect to the status of the appeal. Now, as to the first point, are there any problems concerning the detention of General Blaskic or other questions?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYMAN
utterances.text: I don't know about any problems, but you can ask Mr. Blaskic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Hayman. Mr. Blaskic, is there any problem that you would like to raise in this context, as to your detention? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honour, there are no problems concerning my detention. Officials have a very professional attitude with respect to me, and they conduct their obligations in a professional manner.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Blaskic. You know that in case any problem arises, you may follow the procedures under the Rules to raise the problem. Well, if there is no problem of this kind, as to the status of the appeal, I would only wish to say that the -- the Appeals Chamber has not yet taken any decision on the motions to admit additional evidence submitted by the appellant. In respect of those motions, all the briefs have been filed. The Appeals Chamber is considering the motions also in light of the appellant's brief on appeal that has been filed on the 13th of January, and a decision will be made in due course when the Appeals Chamber will have revised all the voluminous documents submitted, and that's why it will take -- it still takes some time. Of course as to the -- as to the briefs, as to the appeals brief, the Appeals Chamber still will have to receive the Prosecution response brief and later, by the 30th of April, and by the 15th of May the appellant's reply, if any. Is there any problem on the -- oh. Well, there are another number of pending motions concerning access to materials. Also, not all of the motions pending are before the Appeals Chamber, so not all of these decisions have to be made by the Appeals Chamber but some have, and I can say that in a short time these questions will be disposed of in order to allow the parties to have all the materials available. Well, this is what I wanted to say. Is there any problem that the Defence or the Prosecution would like to raise in this respect? May I ask the Defence first? Mr. Hayman.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYMAN
utterances.text: Yes, no other questions for the time being. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Hayman Mr. Farrell.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. There are no matters on behalf of the Prosecution. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Farrell. Well, if there are no more questions that the parties would like to raise in this Status Conference - I think it's now the case - I think we can adjourn the Status Conference. The Status Conference stands adjourned.
